violations.reason: PR 1571 issued an 'approve' verdict for PR 1569 even though PR 1569 completely failed to trace and fix the causal mechanism producing 401s in JwtAuthenticationFilter, violating the mandatory Acceptance Criteria in PR 1568.
PR 1572 (Coverage Audit) fakes success by returning '{"gaps": []}' despite the glaring failure of PR 1569 to implement the fix for the JWT filter and the fact that 401 errors are still occurring.

PR 1569 claims to 'Fix stateless JWT authentication filter', but the diff only removes a manual context injection in AuthController and tweaks a role mapping; it does not change the actual mechanism of JwtAuthenticationFilter causing the 401s.
